level.desc.0: This is where we start learning the basics! Spike lives on the rooftops and loves to share his view on life. If you ever need advice, Spike is at your service, up on the roofs.
level.desc.1: The best way to start the morning is to try out new skills in a quiet suburb. "Can you smell the fresh morning dew on the rooftops?"
level.desc.2: The hospital area is Trix's turf. She is new to running but great at clearing walls. "In the urban jungle you can't be cocky. Choose your route wisely."
level.desc.3: It's getting warmer. Main St. is Dart's territory. "I know long tiger jumps make you faster, but I wear glasses and I'm not that reckless!"
level.desc.4: The roofs and courtyard of the old 1960s museum are a great place to polish your jumps.
level.desc.5: Viper's territory. She is a master of tricks over low obstacles. "Style first!"
level.desc.6: Ninja's territory. It is her favourite part of town, with a fine view of the East and her faraway home. "I'm only here to hang out."
level.desc.7: The old Sand Castle tourist trap is a perfect place for real extreme running.
level.desc.8: The low roofs of the Central Park studio complex are run by Big D. "I heard you can jump, but I'd like to see it!" Stay sharp! Big D is very good, and he knows it.
level.desc.9: Finding your way around the warehouses at night is not easy, so stick with Chili. She was a capoeira champion in São Paulo and knows the docks like her own scars.
level.desc.10: The harbour is a dangerous place. Chili knows a couple of secret shortcuts here but is not keen to share them.
level.desc.11: Congratulations! You made it! Only a few steps separate you from the final challenge, but first you must beat Tung. He is the most skilled guy this side of Paris. "Perfection with passion."
